meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 计算密集型任务开始前，自动检测本机 CPU、GPU（NVIDIA、AMD、苹果芯片）、内存、磁盘和操作系统信息，生成 .claude_resources.json，内含资源快照，以及并行计算、内存策略、GPU 加速等建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出计算密集型任务，如数据分析、模型训练、并行处理等，或要求做资源感知规划时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个50GB的基因组数据集
say.note: 技能先检测资源，再判断是否需要核外计算。

say.text: 我要训练一个神经网络，先检查可用的GPU
say.note: 会检测GPU并推荐对应后端与库。

say.text: 处理10,000个文件，怎么设置并行数

howto.what_en: At the start of compute-intensive tasks, detect CPU, GPU, memory, disk, and OS, and generate .claude_resources.json with resource snapshot and recommendations for parallelization, memory strategy, and GPU acceleration.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions compute-intensive tasks like data analysis, model training, parallel processing, etc., or asks for resource-aware planning.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this 50GB genomics dataset.
say_en.note: It will check resources first and suggest out-of-core processing.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network, check available GPU first.
say_en.note: It will detect GPU backends and recommend suitable libraries.

say_en.text: Process 10,000 files in parallel, how many workers should I use?
say_en.note: It will suggest an optimal worker count based on cores.
